name: jira-ticket
title: {key}
description: One Jira ticket's content, through the claude.ai Jira connector.

source.prompt: Fetch Jira issue {key} with the Jira tools (find the cloudId with getAccessibleAtlassianResources first). Return its summary, status, assignee, priority, its description as Markdown, and its browse URL.

prompt: Create a widget with a tab showing a Jira task's content: key from the session name or branch, summary, status, assignee, description, and a button to put it in the chat.
